title: Noctua announcement frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block at the top of each file in announcements/

title.description: Short headline. Shown in the banner and the panel.

level.description: How urgent it is, which picks the color.

type.description: What kind of thing it is, which picks the icon. Defaults to announcement.

pinned.description: Keep it at the top and stop people dismissing it. Use sparingly.

testing.description: true shows it only on the dev site, never on the live one. Defaults to false.

apps.description: Which apps show this. Omit to show in all of them.

starts.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a 24-hour time (2026-03-14 16:00, Pacific). The day or moment it starts showing. Omit to show immediately.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a 24-hour time (2026-03-14 16:00, Pacific). A bare date runs to the end of that day. Omit to show forever.

descriptionUrl.description: Optional external link for a 'More details' button.
